channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Avicena raises $100M+ Series C to commercialize optical interconnects for AI infrastructure
item.description: Avicena raised over $100 million to commercialize laser-free optical interconnects that move data between AI processors, memory and switches.

item.title: Ulys raises $4M more, taking total funding to $17M for its AI investing app
item.description: AI investing app Ulys raised another $4 million, bringing its total funding to $17 million, to market its app and train its investing models.

item.title: Outcome1 raises €1M Catalyst-led round to build its AI agent platform
item.description: Romanian startup Outcome1 raised €1 million to build its AI agent platform for medium and large businesses.

item.title: EU interim measures order Meta to keep WhatsApp open to rival AI assistants
item.description: The EU has ordered Meta to keep WhatsApp open to rival AI assistants, and Meta is challenging the order in the EU General Court.

item.title: Base44 Nov 23 updates: split field-security rules, new image models, white-label setup
item.description: Base44's latest updates add split create/update rules for field security, new image models, and white-label setup from workspace settings.

item.title: Permut raises €3M seed for AI agents serving e-commerce brands
item.description: Permut raised €3 million to grow its AI agents for online retailers, which handle customer chats, sales and marketing across WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger.

item.title: Leash Biosciences raises $11M to expand AI training environments for scientific agents
item.description: Leash Biosciences raised $11 million to expand automated labs where AI agents practice scientific experiments on real laboratory data.

item.title: Lawvek raises $550K pre-seed for AI agents recovering vendor overcharges
item.description: Lawvek raised $550,000 to help enterprises recover money from vendor overcharges using AI agents that check contracts against invoices.

item.title: MCP passes 700M monthly SDK downloads; Skills over MCP enters public beta
item.description: Anthropic's Model Context Protocol now tops 700 million monthly downloads, with Skills over MCP in public beta and Tasks and Elicitation generally available.

item.title: Anthropic ships 'Install as app' beta: Claude artifacts become standalone desktop apps
item.description: Claude can now turn an interactive artifact into a standalone desktop app for Mac or Windows, with no manual packaging or API keys needed.

item.title: 7.3M x402 payments in 30 days, 92% on Base, median 2 cents
item.description: Base handled 92% of 7.3 million x402 agent payments in the last 30 days, with a median payment of just 2 cents.

item.title: Sierra raises $1.75B Series F at $30B valuation, doubling in six months
item.description: Sierra raised $1.75 billion at a $30 billion valuation, doubling its value in six months as demand for AI customer service grows.

item.title: Coinbase says x402 has processed 160M+ agentic payments as Coinbase for Agents goes live
item.description: Coinbase says its x402 protocol has now processed more than 160 million AI agent payments, and its new Coinbase for Agents tool is live.

item.title: Meta ships WhatsApp Business Tools MCP: Claude, Cursor, Codex and ChatGPT can set up WhatsApp Business
item.description: Meta now lets AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, Codex and ChatGPT set up and manage WhatsApp Business accounts.

item.title: WhatsApp splits marketing errors: new code 131066 from February 2027 for template quality and max price
item.description: WhatsApp will use a new error code from February 2027 so businesses can tell whether a marketing message failed on quality or price.

item.title: Google Workspace MCP servers and CLI now generally available; agents must use MCP from Feb 1, 2027
item.description: Google made its Workspace MCP servers generally available, and AI agents will have to use them instead of direct API access from February 2027.

item.title: Nominal raises $240M Series C at $3B valuation for its industrial-engineering AI agent
item.description: Nominal raised $240 million at a $3 billion valuation for its AI agent that automates root-cause analysis for industrial engineers, with the US Air Force adding a $71.2 million award.

item.title: Instinct: The Hidden Cost of a Free AI Agent — a Nov 24 deep dive into the personal agent's safeguards and defaults
item.description: A new deep dive into Instinct examines the personal AI agent's safety defaults and the billing failure that took it offline on WhatsApp in early November.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.172.0 adds thread links, tab completion and Bedrock Runtime support
item.description: OpenAI's Codex CLI 0.172.0 adds thread links in the terminal, tab completion for slash commands and Bedrock Runtime support for app-server clients.

item.title: OpenAI API adds healthcare configurations of GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with a medical-source search index
item.description: OpenAI's API now offers healthcare versions of its GPT-6.2 models that search only medical sources when web search is turned on.
